$comment: Machine-readable project state. The human-readable companion is MEMORY.md; keep the two in agreement. Validated by scripts/check-memory-freshness.sh in CI.
next_task: Reinstall Docker Desktop (the existing install directory has only leftover installer files, no working docker.exe), then run the integration tests against real Postgres/Redis, then verify one live provider completion end to end with a Gemini key.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.evidence: Workspace, full schema migrations with monthly partitioning, typed config, CI, health endpoints verified against a running gateway, ADRs 001-006.

phases.name: Auth, keys, orgs
phases.evidence: argon2id auth, sessions, API key CRUD with LRU+Redis+PG tiers, audit log, org/member management, dashboard signup/login/keys pages. 14 integration tests written (run in CI).

phases.name: Core gateway
phases.evidence: Nine provider adapters, full twelve-stage pipeline, rate limiting, budgets, BYOK, shared key pool, usage worker, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboard.

phases.name: Optimization engine
phases.evidence: Classifier 98% on 100 labelled fixtures, router with conservative defaults, exact + semantic cache, compressor, circuit breakers, savings attribution. verify-phase.sh 3 passes.

phases.name: Dashboards, billing, launch prep
phases.evidence: Stripe webhook verification, invoice assembly with an independent fee-consistency check, budget alerts, admin console, landing page, docs, savings CSV export, runbooks. All 12 dashboard pages built and browser-verified (models/policies/budgets/team/billing added this session). tests/overhead_under_load.rs measures real pipeline overhead under 64-way concurrency: P99 1.27ms on a debug build.
remaining: P4.8 EXECUTE infra/loadtest/k6-gateway.js against a deployed instance (1k RPS over a real network + database) — the in-process concurrency test is real evidence but is a narrower claim

phases.name: Launch + provider expansion
phases.evidence: All five expansion providers tested. Classifier v2 trained via a real dump/fit pipeline. Status page endpoint. Launch playbook written. Weekly digest now sent by workers/scheduler.rs with a distributed claim (64-way concurrency test proves exactly one replica ever wins a period). Referral program: two-sided credit, self-referral and double-claim guards. CHANGELOG.md written.

phases.name: Enterprise readiness
phases.evidence: Offline license validation with grace period, SCIM 2.0 shapes handling both Okta and Entra deprovisioning, SSO assertion validation with replay detection, per-tenant HKDF keys, region pinning, admin TOTP with the RFC 6238 vector. SCIM/SSO HTTP routes now wired and reachable (tests/route_surface.rs). Compliance pack written (docs/compliance/): security whitepaper, subprocessor list, DPA template, data-flow doc, honest SOC 2 gap analysis. Read replica routing live (AppState::analytics_db()). Self-hosted docker-compose + web Dockerfile added.
remaining: Verify SSO/SCIM against a real Okta or Entra tenant — never done, only shape-tested

phases.name: Scale + moat
phases.evidence: UCB1 outcome bandit with a 3000-step replay showing it beats static routing. TypeScript and Python SDKs, both verified. Regional budgets (fourth scope, isolated per org+region, case-insensitive). Nightly pricing-drift job (reports, never auto-applies). Spend anomaly detection (z-score against org's own 30-day baseline) surfaced at GET /api/usage/anomalies and on the /budgets page. Cost-center chargeback in JSON and CSV. Investor pack (docs/investor/): metrics definitions naming their source code, data-room index.

blockers.summary: Docker Desktop is not functional on this build machine. Checked this session: C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\ contains only tmp-delete\Docker Desktop Installer.exe... (leftover installer fragments), no docker.exe, no daemon. The install did not complete.
blockers.impact: Nothing has been verified against live Postgres, Redis, or Qdrant. The 14+ integration tests compile and skip locally; CI runs them against service containers.
blockers.workaround: Reinstall Docker Desktop from scratch and confirm with `docker version` (not a directory listing) before assuming it works. The gateway compiles and unit-tests with no external service in the meantime.

blockers.summary: No real provider API key has been supplied. User selected Google Gemini via AskUserQuestion in an earlier session but has not yet provided the key.
blockers.impact: The pipeline is verified against a mock provider only, including the new 64-concurrency load test.
blockers.workaround: Add one key and send a single request; the savings figure can then be checked against the provider's own billing.

launch_blockers.summary: 5 of 38 priced models remain marked UNVERIFIED: mistral/mistral-large-latest, mistral/mistral-small-latest, groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile, groq/llama-3.1-8b-instant, moonshot/kimi-k2. The other 33 were checked against live provider pages in an earlier session and carry a checked date.
launch_blockers.impact: Every savings figure and invoice line for these 5 models depends on unverified numbers.
launch_blockers.action: Follow docs/runbooks/pricing-update.md for the 5 remaining rows before billing any customer using them. Verify with: grep -c 'UNVERIFIED.to_string()' apps/gateway/src/metering/pricing.rs (must read 0).

launch_blockers.summary: infra/loadtest/k6-gateway.js has never been executed against a deployed instance. tests/overhead_under_load.rs now provides real in-process evidence (P99 1.27ms, 64-way concurrency, mock provider, debug build) but this excludes network, real DB/Redis contention, and does not reach 1k RPS.
launch_blockers.impact: The sub-1ms P99 overhead claim on the landing page is now partially substantiated, not purely a design target, but the full production-conditions claim is still unverified.
launch_blockers.action: Deploy to staging and run infra/loadtest/k6-gateway.js; record the measured P99 before repeating the claim under production-network conditions.

launch_blockers.summary: No backup has ever been taken, so none has ever been restored.
launch_blockers.impact: Part 13 item 6: an untested backup is not a backup. This is also the single largest gap flagged in docs/compliance/soc2-readiness.md (Availability criterion A1.3).
launch_blockers.action: Run scripts/backup-restore-drill.sh once a database exists and record the result in MEMORY.md.
